post.description: Clears marketing email opt-in for the identity matching the given address, when one exists. Always returns **200** with an empty success payload — never reveals whether the email is known, whether a `user_config` row exists, or the prior opt-in state. Tagged `no-auth` (and therefore CSRF-exempt) so unsubscribe links work without a session.

email.description: Address to unsubscribe from marketing email.

200.description: Request accepted. Does not indicate whether the email matched an account or whether preferences changed.

400.description: Invalid request body (e.g. missing or malformed email).

code.description: A short, machine-readable error code, for when HTTP status codes are not sufficient.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error.
message.example: The requested resource could not be found.
